packages.title: Street Punk crowd pressure: fix the stale avoidance velocity, lock the cadence, then clear the front wedge
packages.notes:
Why this is one package: the three findings share files and depend on each other in order. Finding 02's wall has three causes: finding 01's stale avoidance velocity (enemy_actor.gd), the cadence from finding 03 (punk_attack_cooldown_s), and the director's waiting holders (enemy_actor.gd plus enemy_director.gd). Its own fix says to land 01 first and take 03's retune, and only then judge the director query and the back-step. If two fixers measured in parallel, each would start from the wrong baseline. Package 01 alone, at cooldown 1.4, would probably over-engineer the director query and back-step to get R8 down. A cooldown sweep run before 01 lands would measure the old walk-back. The only file 03 could own on its own is one line in tuning_data.gd's Street Punk subgroup, and its measurements depend on 01. Keeping all three in one package costs some parallelism but keeps the measurements coherent.

Ownership in tuning_data.gd: only the Enemies group's Posture, Director and Street Punk subgroups. Do NOT commit tuning/default.json (the lead regenerates it). To keep test_tuning_panel green locally, you may run `godot --headless -s tools/gen_default_preset.gd`, then `git checkout tuning/default.json` before committing. Say in your report that the preset needs regenerating. Do NOT write docs/milestones/M3-slice-gate.md (the lead writes it). Put every number below in your report so the lead can record it. Do not touch game/actors/combat_actor.gd.

Step 1 (finding 01, high; mechanical, do first and commit on its own):
- In enemy_actor.gd, reset the avoidance agent's internal velocity, not just the preferred one. In _stop() and _stop_reporting(), call `_nav.set_velocity_forced(Vector3.ZERO)` and set `_safe_velocity = Vector3.ZERO`. A reviewer's 'S variant' showed that zeroing `_safe_velocity` alone does nothing.
- In _report_velocity(), use `set_velocity_forced(actual)` so the comment 'tell the neighbours what this body really does' becomes true.
- Also reset at _enter_recover() and at the REACT to APPROACH and ENGAGE to APPROACH transitions.
- Check the method in the 4.7 class reference first: `godot --headless --doctool <dir>`, then NavigationAgent3D.xml.
- Safety net in _apply_velocity(): if the latched safe velocity is more than 90 degrees off `desired` (dot < 0), apply zero that tick, and clamp its length to `desired.length()`. Confirm that test_slice_crowd's 0.7 m min-spacing and no-stuck asserts still hold, so the net does not stop avoidance from separating bodies.
- Add a regression test in test_enemy_actor.gd for the real failure. A Punk walks in at speed, attacks, holds RECOVER, then backs off. On its first walking ticks after the hold, sim_velocity points away from the player (dot > 0) and is no faster than its walk speed. It reaches its slot without orbiting inside about 1.2 m.
- Measure on the slice acts (observed, passive, fight, Waves; seed 0 plus a couple more): the peak Punk speed (it was 4-6 m/s, against a 2.6 m/s walk), and the closest distance to the player during the back-off (it was 0.76-1.1 m).
- The remaining long back-offs around a blocking Punk are P1-int call 17's open slot or back-off decision. Do not try to solve them here; report what is left.

Step 2 (finding 03, medium; on top of step 1):
- Sweep punk_attack_cooldown_s over 4.0, 5.0 and 6.0 (seeds 0-3) on the observed, passive, fight and Waves acts with the probe on.
- For each value, report: posturing Punks on average, Punks in ENGAGE/WINDUP/ATTACK, R8 p95 and the over-half lens share, R12 (passive KO time and the worst 2 s of damage against the limit of 30; it is on the edge now), Waves hits and R13.
- Lock the default in the Street Punk subgroup (tuning_data.gd:669); 5-6 is expected. If Waves pressure drops too far, say so: the remedy is attacker density (the lead's call), not a shorter cooldown.
- Rewrite the doc comment. The cooldown counts from the end of the attack and runs during the recover hold and the walk back, so below about 4 s it never binds.
- Update the table value in tests/test_m3_contracts.gd:473.
- tests/test_enemy_actor.gd:547 sets its own cooldown, so leave it.
- If test_slice_crowd's pressure asserts (grants > 4, hits_on_player > 5, most_attacking > 1) fall below their floors at the new cadence, check that the act still shows the behavior before you touch a threshold. Justify any threshold change in the commit message.

Step 3 (finding 02, medium; only if R8 p95 still misses after steps 1 and 2):
- First repeat the per-enemy lens attribution in observed and passive (the shares from RECOVER, the waiting ENGAGE holders and WINDUP).
- Then, in order and only as far as needed:
  (a) Add a director query in enemy_director.gd, for example the time until may_start_windup() could pass: the gap left, the hit grace left, and an unknown or large value while the player is in HITSTUN or STAGGER. An ENGAGE holder then waits at a standoff (a new @export_range tunable in the Posture subgroup, for example the ring's inner edge) and steps in only when the go is within distance / engage_speed_mps. Keep engage_timeout_s and director_token_timeout_s from expiring tokens that are waiting legitimately. The blind-spot grant must still happen.
  (b) Turn the recover_hold_s stand at strike range into a slow back-step (a new tunable in the Posture subgroup), keeping SPEC §7's punish window: the Punk stays reachable and does not attack.
- Add tests in test_enemy_director.gd and test_enemy_actor.gd.
- Update the ENGAGE and RECOVER description in ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Enemy AI and the rear warning (Milestone 3)' section.
- Do NOT try to fix the APPROACH share in the fight and Waves acts: that is the autopilot's own just-punched target at about 0.85 m. Report its numbers for the lead to argue in the gate file.

Acceptance:
- The full suite passes (tools/run_tests.sh, about 90 s), with no SCRIPT ERROR or ERROR in the output.
- test_slice_crowd's hard rows R1, R2, R3, R10 and R11 pass, and the determinism test passes.
- Record the observed and passive acts with capture_bot.sh and look at first-person sheets: Punks step back after attacking, with no sideways zips and no two-Punk wall at the lens while rear hits land.
- Report R8 p95 per act, the posture share and the R12 margin.
- Run one Godot process at a time and never leave one running. Work in your own worktree, and run `godot --headless --import --quit` there first.
